■ PIXEL OFFICE — TERMS & DISCLAIMER

Last updated: this build. Plain language, no fine print tricks.

1. It is research, not financial advice

Pixel Office is an educational and entertainment tool. Nothing it outputs is financial, investment, legal, tax or accounting advice, and nothing is a recommendation, solicitation or offer to buy or sell any asset. The agents are software characters, not licensed advisers. You are solely responsible for your own decisions. If you need advice, hire a licensed professional in your jurisdiction.

2. Data can be wrong, delayed or missing

Prices and market statistics come from third-party public APIs (currently CoinGecko, Binance, Coinbase, alternative.me, mempool.space and GeckoTerminal). Sentiment and on-chain figures come from those same public endpoints. Data may be delayed, incomplete, rate-limited or simply wrong, and a source can go offline at any time.

The office is built to say "LIVE DATA UNAVAILABLE" rather than invent a number, but you must still verify anything important against a primary source before acting on it.

3. AI answers can be wrong

Desk answers may be written by a language model (a free keyless tier by default, or a provider key that you supply). Language models can be confidently incorrect, and their output is not verified by us. Treat every AI-written sentence as an opinion to be checked, not as a fact.

4. Your API keys, your browser

If you enter a DeepSeek, Claude or ChatGPT API key, it is stored only in your own browser (localStorage) and sent directly from your browser to that provider. We never receive, store or transmit your keys, and there is no server of ours in between. Clearing your browser data removes them.

5. Privacy

  • No accounts, no sign-up, no cookies for tracking, no analytics scripts.
  • Your settings, learning memory and training-data records stay on your device unless you export them yourself.
  • Requests to market-data and AI providers are made directly from your browser, so those providers see your IP address as any website visit would.
  • The exported training file contains your own typed questions and the agents' answers — review it before sharing it.

6. No warranty, no liability

The service is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy or uninterrupted availability. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage — including trading losses — arising from use of this tool or reliance on anything it displays.

7. Fair use

Do not use the tool to break the terms of the data providers it calls, to scrape at volumes their APIs do not allow, or for anything unlawful. Public APIs have rate limits; heavy use may be throttled by them, not by us.

8. Changes

Features, data sources and these terms may change as the project develops. Continuing to use the tool after a change means you accept the updated terms.
